about: vibe/vibe curve factory (testnet, chain 46630), captured 2026-10-19 from the public RPC. `launch`, `first_trades`, `completing` (the buy that reaches the target, after its Completed event), `graduation` (a later transaction) are raw logs of one curve's life (token 0xb339bd49...1b98, curve 0x9e2d5b98...9a20); `replay` is every trade of that curve in order (b: quoteGross, quoteNet, tokensOut, creatorFee, protocolFee; s: tokensIn, quoteGross, quoteNet, creatorFee, protocolFee); `live` is another launch with its launch-time buy and its curve's views.
